title: Partner panel and fee-schedule harness: environment, fixture versions, evidence and gate are not specified, and no panel-version or fee-schedule load operation is published
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md R7.3 and R9; _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-05.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E6-030 lines 11901-11979; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json
description: RWB-ITG-E6030-ITG needs three things no source gives. (a) The harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner and case keys, the panel version and the two fee schedule versions, the service levels by partner type, the business date and the next effective date, the evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check are all unpublished. (b) The Ownership Map publishes GET /partners and the partner-instruction operations of S9 but no panel-version or fee-schedule load operation and no parameter that carries either version, so the version load is RWB-S9-E6030-APP's and is observed here only through the published reads, the reference-data contract of P3 and the decision log. (c) The shape of a versioned reference load and its valid-from rule are published for rule packages and for lov_value (valid_from) but not for the partner panel or the fee schedule, so no field, endpoint or payload of a partner-panel version can be asserted.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-030 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 11901-11979) names the partner, decision_log_entry, rule_row and lov_value entities, the two partner endpoints, SCR-34 and SCR-35, the permission checks, the three messages and TC-E6-030-01 to TC-E6-030-04, and states no environment, fixture, version, date, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 135 (FEAT-PRM-02, prerequisite FEAT-CWC-23) names the outcome only; Business Requirements Program v4 lines 430 and 433 (REQ-S9-001, REQ-S9-004) name the six points and the fee basis only; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.2 lines 173-255 gives the step table, VR-S9-002-1, BR-S9-002, the field catalogue and the two exception criteria and no version shape; TSD S9 Partner management v2 lines 63-106 give the partner and partner_instruction fields and lines 91-99 the four LOV blocks, with no version table; Architecture v5 lines 1245-1256 and 1270-1272 and slide 41 line 2891 give the contract, the event and the schema and no load operation; Temporal and Drools design slide 25 lines 1663-1755 gives the journey and the clocks, and lines 790-798 and 1901-1932 publish valid-from and the refused-load state for rule packages only; ownership.json lists GET /partners, POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions and GET /partner/instructions as S9's, GET /admin/lists/{listCode}, GET /admin/parameters and GET /admin/change-log as P3's, GET /decision-log as P7's and GET /me/session as P4's, and no version-load operation.
area: Integration harness configuration; partner panel and fee-schedule version contract
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check: SIT and the base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner and case keys, the panel version and the two fee schedule versions, the service levels, the business date and the next effective date, the evidence format and retention, and a gate in which a stub pass is never a real pass. Publish the panel-version and fee-schedule load operation, or state that the version in force is read only through the partner read and the decision entry, and publish the valid-from rule for a partner-panel version so the shape can be asserted.
